title: Two Brothers Beat the Maya Lords of Death at Their Own Game

characters.name: Hunahpu
characters.locked_description: Hunahpu, a lean Maya ballplayer of about twenty, a smooth oval face with a small beard-less chin, black spots painted on both cheeks, long black hair under a jade-green headband, a heavy jade ear spool

characters.name: Xbalanque
characters.locked_description: Xbalanque, a lean Maya ballplayer of about twenty, a smooth oval face like his brother, patches of jaguar pelt on both cheeks and forearms, long black hair under a dark blue headband, a heavy jade ear spool

characters.name: Hun Hunahpu
characters.locked_description: Hun Hunahpu, a Maya ballplayer of about forty, a long calm face with a thin moustache, hair in a topknot tied with jade beads, a broad leather hip yoke, knee pads and a feathered headband

characters.name: Vucub Hunahpu
characters.locked_description: Vucub Hunahpu, a younger Maya ballplayer, a rounder cheerful face, hair in a topknot with a red cotton band, a broad leather hip yoke, knee pads, a heavy shell ear spool

characters.name: The lords of Xibalba
characters.locked_description: tall stern lords of the Maya underworld, pale ash-grey painted faces with sunken black eyes, towering headdresses of owl feathers and bone, long mantles woven in black and ash grey, necklaces of carved bone

characters.name: One Death and Seven Death
characters.locked_description: two towering chief lords of Xibalba, one lean with a white skull-painted face, one broad with a face painted half black, each in a vast headdress of black owl feathers and a mantle hung with bone beads

characters.name: The young woman
characters.locked_description: a young Maya woman of about twenty, a calm oval face, long black hair in a single braid, a white cotton huipil with a woven red neckline, a plain jade bead necklace

characters.name: The two soothsayers
characters.locked_description: two aged Maya soothsayers, thin and bent, deep-lined faces, white hair tied up with cords, long plain cotton robes, one with a rattle of gourd and seeds, one with a pouch of copal incense

locations.name: The hall of Xibalba
locations.locked_description: a vast dim underworld council hall of black stone, tall rough columns carved with bone and owl motifs, a long dais with a row of carved stone seats, hearth fires burning low and red

locations.name: The Maya ballcourt
locations.locked_description: a Maya ballcourt, a long narrow I-shaped playing alley between two sloping stone walls of fitted limestone, a carved stone ring set high in each wall, plastered white floor

locations.name: The House of Darkness
locations.locked_description: a pitch-black square stone chamber with rough fitted walls, a low stone doorway sealed by a heavy slab, a bare stone floor, no window and no furniture

key_props.name: The rubber ball
key_props.locked_description: a heavy solid ball of dark brown rubber about the size of a human head, scuffed and slightly flattened on one side, with a faint sheen and a pale chalky mark where it has struck stone

key_props.name: The calabash tree
key_props.locked_description: a tall calabash tree with a gnarled pale trunk, spreading bare branches and a fork at head height, round green and gold gourd fruits hanging from the limbs

key_props.name: The two canes
key_props.locked_description: two tall green maize canes with long ribbon leaves, standing side by side in the packed earth floor of a thatched house, each about as high as a man

notes: Samostalna epizoda, ideja #36 u docs/ideas.md, popunjava regiju North America (Mezoamerika, K'iche' Maje, Gvatemala) i epohu Myth & Legend. Izvor: Popol Vuh, spanski prevod Raynauda (Asturias i Gonzalez de Mendoza, 1927) na Wikisource, poglavlja 11-25 procitana; Spence 1908 je prepricavanje, ne prevod. Narracija snimljena i poravnata (timing.json). 37 shotova (32 klipa + 5 slika), beat mapa odobrena, lockovi i storyboard upisani; vidi notes.md (osa ekrana, režim, šta ostaje). Rezim shota je mesan, birano iz kadra, ne iz kredita. Imena u skripti: Hun Hunahpu, Hunahpu, Xbalanque, Xibalba, One Death i Seven Death (u spanskom prevodu su prevedena po znacenju: Maestro Mago, Brujito, Supremo Muerto). MITSKI REGISTAR: Xibalba i gospodari smrti su veci od pejzaza (sirina podzemnog sveta, dim, sumrak, svetlost koja reaguje); ali bez anahronog dizajna: klasicno/postklasicno majansko ruho (perje, jade, pamuk, maske), ne asteski i ne generican 'tribal'. Lordovi smrti su uobrazeni i radoznali, nisu cudovista; ne crtati ih kao demone iz zapadnog horora. Zivotinjski glasnici su sitne scene (vaska u zabi u zmiji u jastrebu): stilizovano, ne 'cute'. Zrtvovanje i smrt: bez krvi i bez prikazivanja vadjenja srca (skripta ga ne pominje); glava na drvetu i glava koja se vraca na telo prikazati kao slika, ne kao anatomija. Bez golog tela: blizanci i otac u majanskom ruhu. Loptaski teren (pitz) i obruc kao pravi rekviziti; loptu ne crtati kao lobanju osim u kadru gde skripta kaze glava. Dva trske na sredini bakine kuce su vazan rekvizit (znak zivota) i vracaju se u kadar kad se blizanci 'umiru'. Tacnost: broj kuca u prevodima se razlikuje, ne crtati 'Razor House' (to je Wikipedia, ne Raynaud). Skripta nikad ne tvrdi da su blizanci predkolumbijski prikazani na vazama: kaze 'mozda'. Protagonists za publish.md: naslov grupno ('Two Brothers') ili imenuje sve glavne (Hunahpu, Xbalanque, Hun Hunahpu), nikad jednog + deo.
